mapper.sql: id, course_id, exam_matrix_id, quiz_id, requested_by, requested_role, quiz_title, description, prompt, request_snapshot, payload_hash, idempotency_key, strict_mode, code_runner_policy, unlimited, time_limit_minutes, pass_score, start_time, due_time, attempt_limited, display, status, phase, attempt_count, generated_question_count, total_question_count, next_attempt_at, lease_until, error_code, error_message, callback_event_id, processing_at, completed_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO edu.quiz_generation_jobs ( id, course_id, exam_matrix_id, quiz_id, requested_by, requested_role, quiz_title, description, prompt, request_snapshot, payload_hash, idempotency_key, strict_mode, code_runner_policy, unlimited, time_limit_minutes, pass_score, start_time, due_time, attempt_limited, display, status, phase, attempt_count, generated_question_count, total_question_count, next_attempt_at, lease_until, error_code, error_message, callback_event_id, processing_at, completed_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{courseId}, #{examMatrixId}, #{quizId}, #{requestedBy}, #{requestedRole, javaType=edu.ai.lms.common.api.Roles, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, #{quizTitle}, #{description}, #{prompt}, CAST(#{requestSnapshot} AS jsonb), #{payloadHash}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{strictMode}, #{codeRunnerPolicy}, #{unlimited}, #{timeLimitMinutes}, #{passScore}, #{startTime}, #{dueTime}, #{attemptLimited}, #{display}, #{status, javaType=edu.ai.lms.core.quiz.app.domain.QuizGenerationStatus, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, COALESCE(#{phase, javaType=edu.ai.lms.core.quiz.app.domain.QuizGenerationJob$Phase, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, 'TEXT_GENERATION'), COALESCE(#{attemptCount}, 0), COALESCE(#{generatedQuestionCount}, 0), COALESCE(#{totalQuestionCount}, 0), #{nextAttemptAt}, #{leaseUntil}, #{errorCode}, #{errorMessage}, #{callbackEventId}, #{processingAt}, #{completedAt}, NOW(), NOW()) ON CONFLICT (requested_by, idempotency_key) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE edu.quiz_generation_jobs SET quiz_id=#{quizId}, quiz_title=#{quizTitle}, description=#{description}, request_snapshot=CAST(#{requestSnapshot} AS jsonb), payload_hash=#{payloadHash}, strict_mode=#{strictMode}, code_runner_policy=#{codeRunnerPolicy}, unlimited=#{unlimited}, time_limit_minutes=#{timeLimitMinutes}, pass_score=#{passScore}, start_time=#{startTime}, due_time=#{dueTime}, attempt_limited=#{attemptLimited}, display=#{display}, status=#{status, javaType=edu.ai.lms.core.quiz.app.domain.QuizGenerationStatus, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, phase=#{phase, javaType=edu.ai.lms.core.quiz.app.domain.QuizGenerationJob$Phase, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, attempt_count=#{attemptCount}, generated_question_count=#{generatedQuestionCount}, total_question_count=#{totalQuestionCount}, next_attempt_at=#{nextAttemptAt}, lease_until=#{leaseUntil}, error_code=#{errorCode}, error_message=#{errorMessage}, processing_at=#{processingAt}, callback_event_id=#{callbackEventId}, completed_at=#{completedAt}, updated_at=NOW() WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM edu.quiz_generation_jobs WHERE id=#{jobId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM edu.quiz_generation_jobs WHERE requested_by=#{requestedBy} AND idempotency_key=#{idempotencyKey}
mapper.update: UPDATE edu.quiz_generation_jobs SET status='PROCESSING', attempt_count=attempt_count+1, generated_question_count=0, processing_at=COALESCE(processing_at, NOW()), lease_until=#{leaseUntil}, error_code=NULL, error_message=NULL, updated_at=NOW() WHERE id=#{jobId} AND status='PENDING' AND (next_attempt_at IS NULL OR next_attempt_at <= NOW())

UPDATE edu.quiz_generation_jobs SET status='COMPLETED', phase='DONE', lease_until=NULL, completed_at=#{completedAt}, error_code=#{errorCode}, error_message=#{errorMessage}, updated_at=NOW() WHERE id=#{jobId} AND status='PROCESSING' AND phase='VISUAL_GENERATION' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM edu.question_image_generation_jobs WHERE quiz_generation_job_id=#{jobId} AND status IN ('PENDING','PROCESSING') )
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM edu.quiz_generation_jobs WHERE (status='PENDING' AND (next_attempt_at IS NULL OR next_attempt_at <= NOW())) OR (status='PROCESSING' AND lease_until < NOW()) ORDER BY created_at LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM edu.quiz_generation_jobs WHERE status IN ('COMPLETED', 'FAILED', 'TIMED_OUT') AND completed_at < #{cutoff}
